description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for configuring menu items related to attendance features. The class implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses traits to assist with module and screen handling. The core functionality in the configure method overrides the current module to 'time'.

classes.name: AttendanceMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures attendance-related menu options in the OrangeHRM system's user interface. Implements menu configuration and overrides the module to 'time' for the current screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module to 'time' for the given screen; part of the MenuConfigurator interface implementation.
